product_boundary.conditions: four independent nondegenerate Bernoulli bits; distinct subset costs; top4 selection; monotone probability floor preserves ranks
product_boundary.reason: sort modal-bit flip costs a<b<c<d; top3 are empty,a,b; fourth/fifth are ab,c or c,min(ab,d)
product_boundary.implication: Hypercube Hamming-one edges exclude every generic fourth/fifth boundary of a four-bit product router.

real_fisher.equation: real normalized psi: dp=2 psi dpsi, hence CFI=sum(dp dp^T/p)=4 Jpsi^T Jpsi=QFI away from zero amplitudes; a fixed real orthogonal U preserves the input-angle QFI=I
real_fisher.coordinate: four encoding angles before the fixed trained real circuit, not encoder weights and not all trainable circuit parameters jointly
real_fisher.scope: RY/CZ real-state ansatz only; generic complex-state measurements need not saturate QFI; hard top-k and sparse renormalization are outside this smooth metric
real_fisher.implication: A fixed entangling readout changes top-k boundaries without changing the unsmoothed local full-probability Fisher metric in these angle coordinates.
